attBesluta.text: This VEVOR hall tree was exactly what I needed for my entryway. It combines a coat rack, shoe storage, and organizer all in one without taking up too much space. The steel frame feels sturdy and durable, and once assembled, it stands very solid without wobbling. I really like the 4-tier shoe rack because it keeps shoes neat and off the floor, and the hooks provide plenty of room for coats, bags, hats, and backpacks. The side pocket is a nice extra feature for storing smaller items like mail, umbrellas, or gloves. The wire shelf also adds extra storage space. Assembly was straightforward with clear instructions, and the finished look is modern and stylish. It works perfectly in my entryway, great storage solution for staying organized with great value.

This hall tree was exactly what I needed for our closet under our stairs. It combines a coat rack, shoe storage, hooks, and a bench-style shelf all in one, which makes it super functional without taking up too much floor space. I already happened to have a coat rack mounted to the wall an this organizer fit perfectly underneath allowing me to still use the coat rack and all the hooks provided as well. That ended up being super convenient. The industrial wood-and-metal look is really nice and feels more elevated than basic storage racks. Assembly took some time, but the instructions were straightforward. Once put together, it feels sturdy and holds quite a bit, shoes, bags, jackets, hats, and everyday grab-and-go items. I love how much clutter it helped organize instantly. Great option if you need practical storage that still looks nice.
They look nice but the base is not sturdy I had to put them in a pot with some something to hold them in place
I'm so happy with this purchase.. good quality and a good deal

Mega schlagzeug! Meine Tochter lebt und liebt es. Es ist laut! Es macht krach. Nur sonntagsmorgens ist es nicht so geil. Von der Qualität her ein 4 Sterne, da das verstellen der Boxen etwas zu leicht sind und sich immer verschieben und das Pedal, minimal billig wirkt. Zu dem es auch etwas scharfe kanten hat. Der Stuhl ist gut für kinder. Robust und gut gepolstert. Ich hab es mir nur etwas größer vorgestellt, war dann überrascht weil es doch etwas kleiner ist. Aber nimmt dafür dann nicht viel Platz weg. Mehr Freiheit zum Spielen, auch sonntagmorgens. Es ist auch super das zwei verschiedene Drumsticks dabei sind. Kurze und lange für verschiedenen klang. Schöner wäre es noch gewesen ne Tasche dabei. Aber die habe kurzer Hand selbst genäht. UND gehörschutz wäre optimal. Gerade bei den jüngeren Kindern. - Leider nicht enthalten. Aber an sich super Teil. Preisleistung Top!

This drum set is built very well. It is sturdy, built to last. It is made of materials of a better quality than other sets I looked at. The price is great, much less than the junk sets out there. If you have a small one that exhibits the drumming traits, buy this set. You will be happy with your purchase.

Great three piece drum set for my six and three year olds. They love it and it has great sound. The price was also very reasonable. My only regret is perhaps I should have bought the five drum set that comes with a couple more Tom drums and a high hat. Buying them individually after this three price set makes the total price more expensive than the five piece.
Perfect for my son. Fast shipping, great customer and excellent product! Couldn't ask for more.

Bought this drum set for our granddaughter. According to my husband, instructions on how to put the drum set together was easy to follow and tools needed were included. Great quality drum set and great entertainment for your little ones.
My son loves them, takes a bit of time to put together. A good purchase.
